title: TestingPluginService
responsibility: Run installed testing plugin scripts headlessly with resource admission and owned-process cleanup.

inputs.name: TestingPluginService.run.root
inputs.description: Absolute project directory whose declared test script will run.

inputs.name: TestingPluginService.run.id
inputs.description: Installed testing plugin identity; capability and internal modules are rejected.

inputs.name: TestingPluginService.run.args
inputs.description: Additional runner arguments; headed, debug, UI and alternate config switches are rejected.

inputs.name: TestingPluginService.run.signal
inputs.description: Optional cancellation signal for queued admission and the owned runner process tree.

outputs.name: TestingPluginService.run
outputs.description: Zero for a passing runner; a nonzero runner status or cleanup failure otherwise.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid catalog, missing testing installation, headed options, unsafe setup conflicts or process admission prevent execution.
